plan.notes: Source: 'Sample Degree Plan: Bachelor of Science (BS) Psychology', Bulletin Year 2022-2023 (shc.edu Program Checklists page). Sample plan; the Degree Audit in BadgerWeb is the official degree plan per the plan's own footer. Genuine catalog typos kept verbatim: 'THL101 Introduction to Christion Theology' (semester 3; confirmed in the PDF rendering) and 'perquisites PSY263, PSY264' (semester 4, PSY350). Asterisked courses (ENG121, MTH163, Foreign Language I) are pending advising review for placement. Semester 7's second elective prints no hours value; the semester total (15) implies 3 - recorded as 3. Sequenced sum 120 matches the printed 'Total Semester Hours: 120'.
